ns2:section.sectionText: This online section is restricted to Illinois BUS students who will be participating in BUS Study Abroad; BUS Minor students; and Hoeft Technology and Management minor students. Minor students must have completed ACCY 200 and BUS majors must have completed ACCY 201. Students not a member of either of these restricted groups or without completed prerequisites will be removed from the course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Technology and Management or Business minor(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
